name: Kisaki Anju
source:
“Sharing the same last name all of a sudden…
It kind of feels like we got married.”

The protagonist of this story.
She appears cool and logical, but in truth she’s just absent-minded. She had absolute confidence in Japanese-style painting, an art form tied to her own roots—until seeing Itose’s work made her realize the limits of her own talent.

[Translated from the [url=https://lamina-pla.net/Keylabox/chara.html]official website[/url]]
